references.name: whole-station-aerial-2017.jpg
references.observed: Actually inspected2017 aerial: whole long open platform/track corridor with repeated narrow roofs; transverse terminal of red barrel-vault roof groups and attached tall slab, low side/service ranges and street forecourt. Many independent nearby office towers and buildings. Appearance predates major2020s station works; use current PMTiles for footprint/height stacks,not a literal reconstruction of2017 construction,roads or vehicles.

references.name: station-exterior-2023.jpg
references.observed: Actually inspected2023 platform picture. Foreground train obscures most of the building,so this is secondary platform-structure evidence only:red/brown slender metal columns,branching brackets,thin corrugated pitched/flat roof sheets and open sides over native rails/platforms. Do not copy the train,brand signage,wires,people or platform numbers. An ordinary street-front fallback was inspected separately.

references.name: station-front-2008.jpg
references.observed: Actually inspected2008 street front: red metal barrel-vault terminal roofs with deep overhangs,real arched glazed end screens and red vertical frames,brick spandrel,upper terrace and rail,deep pale ribbed fascia above supported recessed closed entrance glazing. Distinct original permanent facade;not evidence of the present construction stage. No copied branding,clock lettering,people,taxis or signs.

note: Two adequate building pictures plus one secondary platform picture inspected. The platform picture is train-obscured;one ordinary street-front fallback was necessary. These reference dates precede or coincide with major works. Author coherent permanent station massing from current map and visible roof/entrance families;explicitly retain temporal/current-work uncertainty. No bespoke sources needed.
